description: Lightsplit is a shared group ledger designed for trips, households, and teams, managed entirely through conversation. Easily create groups and share access via Web, LINE, or Telegram. Track expenses, income, and settlements with equal, weighted, or custom splits across multiple currencies. Attach receipts, optimize debt settlements with minimal transfers, manage shared to-do lists, set budgets, and view category-by-category spending breakdowns effortlessly.
